tasks.label: Sync to deploy dir
tasks.command: cp pkg/*.py pkg/*.sh ~/.local/macwave/pkg/ && cp lib/*.py lib/*.sh ~/.local/macwave/lib/ && cp lib/wave.py ~/.local/macwave/lib/wave && chmod +x ~/.local/macwave/lib/wave ~/.local/macwave/lib/*.sh

tasks.label: Check shell syntax
tasks.command: for f in pkg/*.sh lib/*.sh surfboard/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done

tasks.label: End-to-end test
tasks.command: python3 lib/wave.py install ldid@2.1.5-procursus7 && python3 lib/wave.py info ldid && python3 lib/wave.py list && python3 lib/wave.py uninstall ldid@2.1.5-procursus7
